appearances.title: RTX 5060 Ti eGPU decodes Qwen3.8-27B at 24 tok/s on an M1 Max
appearances.summary: An RTX 5060 Ti in a Thunderbolt box, attached to an M1 Max MacBook Pro running Linux, decodes Qwen3.8-27B at 24 tokens per second. That is 2.6 times the speed of the laptop's own GPU in the same test.

appearances.title: ConnectX-5 comes up on a MacBook Pro under Linux
appearances.summary: Joshua Warren got a ConnectX-5 Ex 100-gigabit card to probe, read its firmware, and bring up both ports in a Thunderbolt dock on an M2 Max MacBook Pro running Linux. He published an open guide and said a DGX Spark is the next machine to connect.

appearances.title: One Mesa setting lifts Qwen on an AMD RX 9070 eGPU over Thunderbolt from 25 to 33 tok/s on an M2 Max running Linux
appearances.summary: Setting RADV_PERFTEST=dmashaders on an RX 9070 (16 GB) attached over Thunderbolt to an M2 Max MacBook running Omarchy Linux raised Qwen generation from about 25 to 33 tokens per second with identical greedy output. The steps are in the open omarchy-egpu repo.
